## I2 closure evidence

Functional CI is green and the local real-AMU U50 OOC package closes timing at 156.25 MHz.

```text
Synth WNS    +2.318 ns
Placed WNS   +1.111 ns
Routed WNS   +1.078 ns
Routed TNS    0 ns
LUT          3396
FF           2383
RAMB36         19
RAMB18          1
DSP             10
Routing errors    0
```

The first routed attempt failed at WNS `-6.866 ns`; futures state/margin evaluation was then structurally pipelined. The repaired worst path is now in the frozen AMU BRAM/candidate-selection path, not the futures state manager.

Durable result: `docs/results/i2_futures_state_ooc_postroute.md`.

## Next phase

I3 will own CL2EX admission:

```text
frozen HFT 256-bit order_data
  -> field/account/product adapter
  -> fail-closed policy
  -> futures RESERVE
  -> AMU order-context INSERT
  -> PASS original payload to frozen R01 encoder
```

The admission transaction must be atomic. No rejected or half-admitted order may reach R01, and a failed AMU insertion must not leave a futures reservation behind.

## Claim limit

I2 establishes futures state/reconciliation functionality and OOC physical feasibility. It does not yet establish the final full HFT+RMIC top, end-to-end HFT latency with RM enabled, board packet latency, TAIFEX SPAN, or exchange conformance.
